# `aitbc system run-script`

Run an allowed AITBC maintenance or monitoring script.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system run-script [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | text | — | yes | Absolute path to an allowed AITBC script |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system run-script --path <path>
```
